hypotheses.H4_note: H4 did not support a pure closure-deficit attribution in any trigger case.

minimum_tested_state_placement.evidence: PLACEMENT_SUPPORTED against U4 for B01 and B14 at equal dimension and fixed CURRENT_LAYER_FACE closure.

SURF_P.remaining_fidelity_limit: Same-partition four-cell Richards leaves the frozen qualified numerical domain under the prospectively fixed fallback policy, so closure versus representation cannot be adjudicated.

minimum_tested_state_placement.evidence: PLACEMENT_SUPPORTED against U4 for B01 and B14 at equal dimension and fixed CURRENT_LAYER_FACE closure.

GW_LB.remaining_fidelity_limit: Numerically qualified same-partition four-cell Richards also misses the frozen R512_T32 comparator, so closure versus four-state information/spatial resolution cannot be separated.

admitted_conclusions: Hydrologically useful vertical state placement is purpose-dependent within the frozen equal-dimension four-state family.
Surface/profile response benefits from upper-column-aligned S4 placement relative to U4 for both qualified materials.
Groundwater/lower-boundary response benefits from bottom-adjacent G4 placement relative to U4 for both qualified materials.
Equal state count and fixed CURRENT_LAYER_FACE closure do not erase the information value of where the four states are placed.
explicitly_not_admitted: Four states are a universal or absolute minimum representation.
Four states are sufficient for either application purpose.
CURRENT_LAYER_FACE is proven to be the sole remaining fidelity limitation.
A specific replacement closure family is required or admitted.
unresolved_scientific_boundaries: SURF_P: same-partition four-cell Richards is outside the frozen qualified numerical domain, preventing closure-versus-representation attribution.
GW_LB: same-partition four-cell Richards is numerically qualified but still below the frozen R512_T32 comparator, leaving four-state information versus spatial-resolution insufficiency unresolved.
next_authority_rule: Any further study that changes state count, introduces a new closure family, changes the surface CoRichards numerical policy, or seeks application acceptance requires a new prospective authority/preregistration. P2 itself is closed.
